notes: Partition verified: 28 source and 42 target IDs each used exactly once.

עַל פְּנֵי is split (*upon* / *open*) because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, which rule 30's subtraction test requires; the same pair fuses into *before* in v.10, and each verse is read on its own evidence.
Both *the*s of *the birds of the heavens* and of *the whole earth* are placed by rule 29's count of which word each stands before.
